rejected.title: Paid school administrator role
rejected.reason: The fresh official notice describes broad school administration, switchboard work, and administrative support to leadership, but identifies no concrete bounded chore. There is no honest task-specific experiment to assess without inventing duties; no candidate was scored.

steps.message: No post proposed: the only selected education lead is a fresh paid school administrator vacancy, but its text gives broad role duties rather than a concrete bounded chore. Rejected that lead without inventing task evidence or ratings.
